implementation_constraints: Implement only SLICE-P02 Identity and ApplicationSession persistence.
Do not introduce Credential, Invitation, token, Membership, Organization, authorization, audit, or other slice tables.
Identity is not Organization-owned and must not acquire organization/location/role/capability authority columns.
ApplicationSession belongs to exactly one Identity through a required identity reference.
Protected ApplicationSession repository operations require authoritative IdentityId.
Persist only the v1 verifier of a 32-byte session credential; never persist the raw credential.
Enforce the 12-hour absolute and 30-minute idle lifetime semantics without making denial depend on an expiry-state write.
Do not implement Identity DELETED ingress, purge, anonymization, or retention policy while C15 policy questions remain unresolved.
Do not implement cookie SameSite/Domain/Path, CSRF, session rotation, or transport behavior from this admission.
Every schema change ships with an immutable ordered migration; do not edit 0000 or execute shared/production migration.
Repository writes remain owned by the Identity module; foreign modules may not write P02 persistence directly.
